professionalSummary.text: Onboards new distribution-centre sites onto the scheduling product and tracks onboarding milestones.
professionalSummary.witness: Onboarded fourteen distribution-centre sites across four customers onto the scheduling product, tracking each site's milestones (dock configuration, shift templates, first automated week) in the onboarding tracker.

experienceHighlights.text: Runs the quarterly health check with each assigned customer and records actions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the quarterly health check with each of my nine assigned customers, walking through slot utilisation and open tickets and recording agreed actions in the account notes.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Raises the share of assigned sites using automated slot allocation, reported against the quarterly baseline.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Automated slot allocation was in use at 21 of my 32 assigned sites at the end of Q2, up from 12 of 32 at the end of Q4 the previous year, according to the customer success adoption dashboard against the team's quarterly baseline of 12 sites.

skills.text: Coordinates escalations with support and product and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated escalations with support and product through the escalation board; fixes and roadmap commitments were decided by the product manager.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's onboarding, quarterly health checks, automated slot allocation, escalation coordination, and documentation of limitations and hand-over conditions. They do not establish the candidate's ability to raise the share of sites using automated slot allocation beyond the reported figures.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and documentation of onboarding, quarterly health checks, automated slot allocation, escalation coordination, and documentation of limitations and hand-over conditions are established.
